Simulated Six-Arm Dose-Finding Trial

Source: R/data.R
selectaex6.Rd

A synthetic dataset of 3,600 patients in a six-arm dose-finding trial. Structure matches selectaex2 with six treatment arms.

Usage

selectaex6

Format

A data.table with 3,600 rows. See selectaex2 for column descriptions.

Examples

data(selectaex6)
str(selectaex6)
#> 'data.frame':	3600 obs. of  16 variables:
#>  $ patient_id            : chr  "DOS0001" "DOS0002" "DOS0003" "DOS0004" ...
#>  $ site                  : Factor w/ 8 levels "Site Alpha","Site Beta",..: 2 4 2 3 2 8 5 7 2 2 ...
#>  $ screening_date        : Date, format: "2022-01-01" "2022-01-01" "2022-01-01" "2022-01-01" ...
#>  $ age                   : num  54 51 68 69 54 34 29 39 47 60 ...
#>  $ has_consent           : logi  TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE ...
#>  $ prior_therapy         : logi  FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE TRUE ...
#>  $ ecog                  : int  0 1 4 3 0 0 0 3 2 0 ...
#>  $ creatinine            : num  1.15 0.92 0.97 0.63 1.19 0.78 1.63 0.94 0.97 0.79 ...
#>  $ eligible              : logi  TRUE TRUE FALSE FALSE TRUE FALSE ...
#>  $ exclusion_reason      : chr  NA NA "ECOG >= 3" "ECOG >= 3" ...
#>  $ is_duplicate          : logi  FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE ...
#>  $ treatment             : Factor w/ 6 levels "Placebo","5 mg QD",..: 5 1 NA NA 2 NA NA NA 1 5 ...
#>  $ received_treatment    : logi  TRUE TRUE NA NA TRUE NA ...
#>  $ discontinued          : logi  FALSE FALSE NA NA FALSE NA ...
#>  $ discontinuation_reason: chr  NA NA NA NA ...
#>  $ completed_study       : logi  TRUE TRUE NA NA TRUE NA ...
table(selectaex6$treatment)
#> 
#>   Placebo   5 mg QD  10 mg QD  25 mg QD  50 mg QD 100 mg QD 
#>       416       424       408       413       399       407
